decision.match_bounded_intermediate: First child validated before model Vec; at most three matching wrapper hints. Fixes memory amplification but take(3) AFTER filter can still rescan arbitrarily many unknown RefFields. Replaced structurally, not discarded noisy samples.
decision.prefix_bounded_final: First child fully decoded before model Vec. Hint inspects at most FIRST FOUR ALREADY PARSED RefFields before filtering number/wire, capacity max4 and min1. Matching wrappers are not proof of child validity. Subsequent output growth happens only after successful decoding of the next child. Empty list allocates no output Vec. Sparse2 can retain baseline capacity4 rather than scanning the whole unknown tail.
